order: That has led to plenty of rotation on Tuesday in a rivalry game Pochettino will still be keen to win.

Mauricio Pochettino has enjoyed plenty of success with a youthful roster in this window, the first after the 2026 World Cup. The USMNT coach has already given 12 players their first caps, eight of whom are teenagers.

Pochettino has been consistently trotting out lineups with a mix of newcomers and stalwarts, and that is likely to continue at Allianz Field in St. Paul, Minnesota.
